plugin.name: Bend2
plugin.description:
Language support for Bend 2 in IntelliJ IDEA.
  • Syntax highlighting, hash line comments, and editable snippets
  • Completion, parameter information, parameter hints, constructor-case generation, and explicit imports
  • Go to Declaration, Go to Symbol, Find Usages, static dependency inspection, and source Quick Documentation
  • Manual and optional background compiler checking of unsaved source and imports
  • Selectable proof roots, law/fill navigation, proof progress, Run and Build configurations
  • Foreign source paths, previewable file refactoring, templates, and optional IDE spelling assistance
Editing works without a Bend installation. Checking requires a configured Bend compiler with --check-only support. See the README for setup and current limitations.
plugin.change-notes:
Version 0.1.5:

  • Add parameter information, semantic selection, parameter hints, match-case generation, and explicit import actions
  • Select and check proof roots; navigate laws, fills, and holes; browse proof work and open or create law fills
  • Add Bend Run, Build, and Native configurations, foreign import navigation, file refactoring, dependency inspection, templates, and spelling support
  • Improve editor responsiveness, compiler result freshness, and proof workflow diagnostics
